spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact current surface (LanguageDetector.availability(), create(), detect()) plus the legacy translation.canDetect(), reporting raw returned values — 'downloadable' was reported verbatim on the test build, not bucketed into an old vocabulary.

interactive.rationale: Six sample buttons, textarea, detect and clear controls; detection runs for real and every result is provenance-labelled (model vs page heuristic).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Lede promises probe-both-routes with raw values and provenance labels; the page delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Fallback, absent-global and throw paths all surfaced; after the 2026-09-27 fix the model-path throw reason stays visible alongside the fallback provenance label (verified on a fresh reload: header reads 'source: … heuristic … — the model path was probed and threw: …').

references.rationale: chromestatus.com/feature/5087964794322944 linked in the lineage note and see-also.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level conformance.json present; assertions target the real availability()/detect() contract.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via repo CDP harness: probes rendered (availability() → 'downloadable' raw), Japanese sample + detect exercised, result ja 85.2% correctly labelled as the page's own heuristic, console clean, 0px overflow on 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800.

telemetry_health.rationale: Telemetry is injected by the server shell; no unexpected errors during the click-through.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout; fallback and model result headers use distinct labelled borders, not color alone.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled textarea, native buttons, role=status aria-live results header.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Android-first layout verified at both classes: 0px overflow, clean console.

openQuestions.title: Concept-count heuristic vs lineage reality
openQuestions.detail: The worklist flags this folder thin (0 concept subfolders). The feature id is deeply covered by its lineage (v130: 6, v138: 4, v148: 6+ concepts) and this page's role is the Android-availability listing with a working probe + labelled detector, per its lineage note. Per AGENTS.md 'One demo folder per feature', additional near-duplicate concepts here would re-demonstrate a covered API; if the heuristic should treat lineage-satellite folders differently, that is a worklist change for a human to confirm.

summary: Interactive Android-listing page over the real LanguageDetector surface with honest provenance labelling, verified with the repo headless-Chrome CDP harness on both classes before and after the goal-setting fix. Fixed in place: the fallback header no longer overwrites the model-path throw reason (smallest patch, one handler). Depth for this feature id lives in its lineage folders (v130/v138/v148); this satellite page intentionally stays a single availability-focused demo.

guidanceConsulted.query: status message live region append failure reason without spamming announcements
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep one polite live region per status surface and put the complete outcome in it rather than issuing competing messages.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The fix appends the model-failure reason to the existing role=status #resultsHead text in the same update pass, so assistive tech announces one complete message instead of a message that is immediately replaced.
